name: 32183-imageprefill-qwen3vl4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one engine instance, run in-process rather than behind an HTTP server.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, 4.4B params: a native-resolution ViT over a 36-layer language model. Shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 20%, no cooldown, bounded at 400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, static seed 32183.
workload: single-turn image+text: one 1024x1024 JPEG plus a 325-token instruction per request, 40 tokens generated. guidellm `synthetic_text` (prompt and output pinned min=max) composed with `synthetic_image` (1024x1024, 1 image per request, jpeg q85, content `gradient`, seed 32183). Images are row-index seeded, so no two requests carry the same pixels.
purpose: A vision assistant answering short questions about single high-resolution photos for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Launch config for 32183-imageprefill-qwen3vl4b-1gpu, in the form `vllm serve --config` takes.
#
# RUNNER HAZARD: this era's AsyncEngineArgs raises TypeError on an unknown key at construction,
# so a key borrowed from a later engine breaks the run rather than being ignored.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: float32

max-model-len: 4096

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

enable-prefix-caching: false
